Play, Explore and Learn.

Programs of Hill Top Primary School include world-class curriculum and knowledgeable child development professionals that meet the needs of children at every age and stage.

About Our Center

We offer a play-based emergent curriculum complete with low teacher to child ratios. Come see our environment and how it is designed to promote exploration, adventure and imaginative play. We believe that children are active participants in their own learning. That's why we encourage them to ask questions and explore the world around them.

Hill Top Primary School

A Place Where Learning Feels Alive

Our school compound gives children room to discover, play, and grow in a safe and inspiring environment. Every corner is designed to support creativity, confidence, and joyful learning.
